verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Slack integration blurb saying users can 'approve offers', which implies some offer-approval workflow exists. Nothing in the pack documents approval routing for job openings or postings, configurable multi-step approval chains, or a gate that blocks publishing or sending until approval. Missing for 10: job opening/posting approval workflows, configurable multi-approver chains, evidence that offers are blocked from sending until approved, in-depth first-party docs on approvals, independent or hands-on corroboration.
